text:
Nora: quick sync  field asks for a "conversion bridge" pattern so customers can buy a marketplace discoverable SKU and then seamlessly convert to a reserved/private contract with co-fund support from SIs. Need rules + safety guards.

Diego: high level: marketplace for visibility, private for escrow/KMS or >$300k ARR. Conversion bridge ok if initial purchase doesn't require escrow. Bridge should spawn a private contract at conversion time.

Hannah: important: co-fund (partner subsidized) offers must be explicit opt-in by partner during listing. Checkout shows gross price; partner payout handled off-invoice via Partner Portal credits. No hidden discounts in marketplace UI.

Ethan: telemetry idea: emit "conversion_candidate" when rolling usage >=75% of virtual SKU band for 45d OR projected run-rate > commit band. Include customer_id, sku, pct_util, trend. Attach to sales+partner_ops.

Priya: legal: add clause that purchasing a conversion-eligible marketplace SKU authorizes creation of a private contract for onboarding/escrow where required; conversion terms include any partner co-fund agreements. Will draft.

PartnerBot: NOTE: marketplace cannot natively hold escrow or apply deferred partner coupons. See ticket: https://redwood.internal/tickets/PRT-7422

Nora: routing rules proposal: 1) Escrow or KMS required -> private PO only. 2) >$300k ARR -> private by default (seller can request opt-in). 3) Conversion-eligible marketplace SKU -> published only if partner opts into co-fund and partner agrees to off-invoice credits. 4) Marketplace quota hit -> auto-create private PO; notify seller and partner 48h before failover.

Diego: billing model: marketplace charges initial tranche; conversion flow generates a private PO for remaining committed value and applies partner co-fund credits. Ops issues reconciliation at renewal. Overage billed at list unless upgraded mid-term.

Hannah: partner transparency: post-purchase email should include partner_split, co-fund amount, PCD link, and expected payout timeline. Also include steps to accept migration to private contract.

Ethan: alert playbook: when conversion_candidate fires, create a play task for sales with suggested script + renewal incentive options (stair-step coupons: 12%/8%/5% for 30/60/90 day accept windows). Coupons applied off-invoice on private PO.

Priya: Legal asks for sample clause language and opt-in checkbox text. I'll produce draft by Friday.

Nora: ops/engineering: need a small reconciliation microservice to map marketplace_sku -> private_contract_template and apply partner credits. Estimate effort ~2 weeks. Canary the workflow on a 3-partner pilot.

PartnerBot: Approval checklist: security review required for any hardware-bundled or GovCloud-eligible listings. Ticket: https://redwood.internal/tickets/PRT-7480

Nora: timeline and action items: Priya -> legal clause + opt-in copy (due Fri). Diego -> prototype reconciliation mapping + rough ETA (due Wed). Ethan -> telemetry alert spec + sample payload (due Tue). Hannah -> post-purchase partner summary email + checkout note copy (due Thu). I'll open the PR for conversion-bridge and tag Security + Partner Ops.

Ethan: thanks all, will start on telemetry spec.

Diego: will sketch the mapping table and sequence diagram.

PartnerBot: PR opened: https://redwood.internal/prs/9240  partnerships/conversion-bridge-cofund (Nora).
